I need the authoritative inputs before calculating, so I’m checking the available knowledge source first and then Wikipedia if needed.

```python
knowledge_lookup = await knowledge_search_knowledge("Eliud Kipchoge marathon world record pace Moon minimum perigee Wikipedia", scope="session")
print(knowledge_lookup)
```
The session documents did not provide the needed figures, so I’m retrieving the relevant Wikipedia pages directly.
```python
wikipedia_lookup = await web_search("Wikipedia Eliud Kipchoge marathon world record time Moon minimum perigee distance closest approach", max_results=5)
print(wikipedia_lookup)
```
I’m using the source values from the search results and will now compute the travel time in hours, converting the marathon pace to hours per kilometre and using the minimum perigee distance.
```python
wikipedia_lookup = await web_search("Wikipedia Eliud Kipchoge marathon world record time Moon minimum perigee distance closest approach", max_results=5)
print(wikipedia_lookup)
```

```

```
The required calculation is \(356400 \div (421.95 \div 2.0191667)\); I’m evaluating it directly and rounding to the nearest 1000 hours.
2000 hours
